title: A Quo Omarchy plugin policy result candidate v1

reasons.x-a-quo-order: strict tuple order: code in the declared enum order, disposition block before require_consent, provider_id null first then raw ASCII, rule_id null first then raw ASCII; duplicates forbidden

reason.x-a-quo-semantic: provider_id is required for provider-scoped codes from missing_required_provider through new_provider_error and from permission_expansion through capability_rule; it is null for all other codes. rule_id is non-null only for capability_rule. interactive_approval_required is require_consent; publisher_not_authorized, publisher_continuity_not_matched, manifest_validator_not_passed, plugin_id_changed, and version_not_upgrade are block. unknown_capability, default_capability, and capability_rule dispositions must equal the referenced local-policy setting or rule; default_capability uses the distinct default_capability code, a bound provider_id, and null rule_id

x-a-quo-semantic: install requires null delta; update requires a digest; canonical input digests and reasons derivable without provider-envelope semantics are recomputed; provider-derived unknown/default/rule reasons are shape-checked, digest-bound, and checked against local-policy dispositions but are not independently derived; decision is block if any reason blocks, otherwise require_consent
x-a-quo-nonclaim: require_consent is a blocked-or-prompt-required parser result in Stage 0, not package eligibility, safety, or unattended authorization
